title: Local worker orchestration MVP: docs and proof
description: Deliver executable proof and documentation for local worker orchestration in local control-plane mode. Scope: local task dispatch worker path, local console/chat worker path, deterministic smoke scripts, and runbook updates. Out of scope: OIDC, autoscaling, and production observability implementation.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Worker orchestration MVP slice implemented in feature/local-control-plane-mvp. Added strict local worker smokes (task dispatcher + chat worker), one-command worker proof harness, dedicated runbook, and MVP runbook link. Verification passed: bash scripts/smoke-local-task-dispatch.sh, bash scripts/smoke-local-chat-worker.sh, bash scripts/prove-local-worker-orchestration.sh. Proof artifacts now written to tmp/local-control-plane-proof/{task-dispatch.json,chat-worker.json,worker-orchestration.json}. Also hardened CLI startup so optional data command dependency failures do not block non-data command execution in local dispatch flows.
